analysis: Both changed files are XCTest/Swift Testing sources under provider-swift/Tests; no production code, protocol, key handling, attestation, or cache logic changes in the supplied evidence. QwenVLMTargetExtractionTests.swift (head lines 337-367) adds a test, endOfPromptBoundaryRequiresDensePagedSSD, that asserts EngineV2Factory.demandedLatestCheckpointMinimumTokens returns the store's minEffectiveTokens floor only for the dense model with the paged backend and an actual SSD store. It returns nil for MoE, contiguous, nil-store and contiguous-store configurations, and demandedCaptureBoundaryMinimumTokens stays nil for dense. This pins gating behavior relevant to T-041 (per-donation SSD gate, benefit floor). It does not weaken the gate. The test uses temporary fixture directories (SSDHybridCheckpointTestFixture) and cleans up with defer. Other test content (lines 1-336 and 369-1019) appears pre-existing and only contextual. It uses synthetic keys and hashes and no real secrets. NemotronSuperLocalOutputTests.swift (line 37) adds a `.logprobs` case returning "L" to an exhaustive switch, so the test compiles against a new enum case. That implies a production enum change (a logprobs event) elsewhere in the PR. Whether logprobs output is encrypted or handled fail-closed under T-008, or could leak token probabilities, cannot be judged from this batch. Integration should check the production logprobs event path, which is not in this batch. No regressions identified in the supplied test-only changes.
